# Requirements Quality Checklist: SPEC-0007 Agent/Admin Management, Security-Day Gate, Public Site, and Professional UI Theme

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements writing — validate that the SPEC-0007 requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and cover all scenarios. Tests the requirements themselves, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | **Plan**: [plan.md](../plan.md) | **Research**: [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. All 37 items verified 2026-08-17 against the remediated spec/plan/tasks/contracts (post `/speckit.analyze`); the 7 previously-open gaps (CHK002/008/022/025/026/027/030) were resolved in the artifacts.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are agent CRUD field-level requirements defined for all agent attributes (address, contact, people, financial, memberships)? [Completeness, Spec §9 FR-001..003] — full field set in `contracts/agents-api.md` §1/§6, referenced by spec §15
- [x] CHK002 Is the initial-password delivery mechanism for newly created agent logins specified? [Gap, Spec §9 FR-001/BR-009] — **RESOLVED**: BR-009 states out-of-band delivery (manual handover); email/SMS delivery is Phase 2 Notifications; also noted in `contracts/agents-api.md` §6
- [x] CHK003 Are agent list search/filter requirements defined (viewagent.asp parity)? [Gap, Spec §9 FR-002] — **RESOLVED (F2)**: `?q=` keyword filter on entries/statuses routes (FR-021, §15); list filter in `contracts/agents-api.md` §5
- [x] CHK004 Are per-page requirements defined for each public site page in §6.12 (content and behavior)? [Completeness, Spec §9 FR-010] — per-page inventory in `contracts/ui-contract.md` §5, T035
- [x] CHK005 Is the security-day "today" status view requirement defined (securityHome.asp parity)? [Completeness, Spec §9 FR-008] — **RESOLVED (F3)**: `GET /api/v1/admin/security-day/today` added to §15 and `contracts/admin-api.md` §3
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for the agent self-service account view (AgentAccount.asp) beyond the self-update action? [Completeness, Spec §9 FR-020] — FR-020 view + self-update; portal account page T031

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the deactivation behavior defined with concrete runtime semantics (login blocked, data preserved, reversible)? [Clarity, Spec §9 FR-004] — **RESOLVED (F6)**: §12 mechanism (Identity-store lock + `Active` flag, atomic), data-model §1 lifecycle
- [x] CHK008 Is the legacy `agents.Active` value convention specified for the deactivation flag? [Ambiguity, Spec §16] — **RESOLVED**: `'Y'` = active, `'N'` = inactive, verified from legacy source (`addnewagents.asp:57`, `editdoneagent1.asp:54-57`, `connection.asp:39`); recorded in §16, data-model §1, research.md R-007; T003 confirms no anomalous live values
- [x] CHK009 Is the public-query rate limit quantified with a specific threshold? [Clarity, Spec §9 FR-011] — **RESOLVED (F8)**: "5/hour per source" in FR-011 and `contracts/public-api.md` §1
- [x] CHK010 Is "parity" for public pages defined (functional + content under the new theme)? [Clarity, Spec §9 FR-010] — session 2026-08-17 resolution in FR-010 (functional + content parity, legacy defects fixed)
- [x] CHK011 Is the WCAG-AA baseline quantified (contrast ratios, focus, keyboard navigation)? [Clarity, Spec §14] — WCAG-AA level (incl. 4.5:1 contrast) in `contracts/ui-contract.md` §3, §14 baseline, AC-010/AC-015, T037

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Are deactivation semantics consistent between FR-004 (agents) and FR-023 (users)? [Consistency, Spec §9] — both use the same §12 mechanism (Identity-store lock, reversible, nothing deleted)
- [x] CHK013 Is the own-agent scoping rule (BR-007) applied consistently across FR-017..021? [Consistency, Spec §10] — claim-bound `AgentId` on all portal routes (§15, contracts §3/§3a/§4)
- [x] CHK014 Is the UserManagement role set consistent between spec §15 (`adm`,`emp`) and the existing policy catalog (`adm`,`su`)? [Conflict, Spec §15] — resolved as DP-001 in plan.md (correct policy to `adm,emp`; `su` passes via inherited `adm` claim)
- [x] CHK015 Do the API contracts' authorization policies match the spec §15 role sets? [Consistency, Spec §15, contracts/] — **RESOLVED (F3/F11)**: §15 aligned with all contracts; role shorthand normalized to policy names (`AgentSelf` = `agt,emp,adm,su`, `AgentLedger` = `agt,emp,adm,su`)

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are all acceptance criteria objectively verifiable (status codes, behaviors)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §20 AC-001..018] — all ACs state concrete outcomes (401/403/409, own-only, blocked login)
- [x] CHK017 Is AC-006 (public parity) measurable given the parity definition? [Measurability, Spec §20 AC-006] — parity = same pages/content/behavior + no demo dropdown + UTF-8; T033/T035/T039
- [x] CHK018 Is the WCAG-AA check method specified for AC-010 (tool/automation)? [Measurability, Spec §20 AC-010] — **RESOLVED (F9)**: axe-core named in AC-010 and `contracts/ui-contract.md` §3
- [x] CHK019 Is AC-016 (deactivated login rejected) testable end-to-end? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §20 AC-016] — T012/T013/T048 integration tests; §12 mechanism defines the rejection path

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are alternate flows covered — opening an already-open day (409)? [Coverage, Spec §18] — `contracts/admin-api.md` §1 (409), T023
- [x] CHK021 Are exception flows covered — closing a day with no open row (404)? [Coverage, Gap] — `contracts/admin-api.md` §2 (404), T023
- [x] CHK022 Are concurrent-write scenarios covered (two admins opening/closing the day simultaneously)? [Coverage, Gap] — **RESOLVED**: BR-003 atomic-per-date semantics + `contracts/admin-api.md` §1/§2 concurrency notes + T023 concurrency test (exactly one 200, other 409)
- [x] CHK023 Are recovery flows covered — reactivation after deactivation? [Coverage, Spec §9 FR-022] — FR-022/AC-016, §15 `/reactivate`, T014, T013

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Is the edge case of deactivating an agent with existing entries/ledger addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §9 FR-004] — BR-006 (deactivate, never delete; references preserved), §12 mechanism
- [x] CHK025 Is the edge case of a duplicate username on agent/user creation addressed? [Edge Case, Gap] — **RESOLVED**: BR-009 + `contracts/agents-api.md` §6 (409 Conflict); admin-api §4 already states unique username
- [x] CHK026 Is the edge case of an `agt` user without a linked AgentId addressed? [Edge Case, Gap] — **RESOLVED**: §12 (unlinked `agt` → 403 on portal routes); user creation with `role=agt` always links a valid agent (admin-api §4 `agentId` required); T048 test scenario
- [x] CHK027 Are empty/zero-state requirements defined for agent lists, entries lists, and statements? [Edge Case, Gap] — **RESOLVED**: §14 zero-state requirement (friendly empty-state message) + T050 coverage task
